purpose: Prove durable result custody in an actually isolated worktree without mutating the controller checkout before concurrent material Wave A dispatch.
required_assertions: The producer uses the best-of-n isolated-worktree runner and never checks out, rebases, resets, or otherwise changes the controller workspace.
The producer starts from a commit descended from 90d2288fb9613312be8f055bd74bf8d19edeb317 that contains the active transactional protocol.
The producer writes only its declared owned subtree on its unique runner branch.
The canary payload exactly matches the nonce and content declared by the immutable task input.
The producer emits a complete artifact manifest with SHA-256 and byte counts.
The producer commits and pushes the result to a unique remote branch.
A distinct controller process reads every artifact from the immutable remote commit and verifies bytes and hashes.
The controller checkout branch and HEAD observed before dispatch are unchanged when the producer returns.
Provider completion without a durable result commit is classified PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED.
Only the controller may record COMPLETED and the producer may not independently accept its own result.
